Ver3.7

 Thank you, developers.



Ver.3.62

新機能、データベースの切り替えによって過去の誤った軌跡データを消して、まっさらな地図に新しく旅を始められるようになりました。
外部アプリを使えば、今度こそ綺麗な軌跡を書き込むことができます。（非常に時間と手間はかかりますが）

おそらく通った場所をデータ上に加算していく形で統合データを形成しているため、軌跡を消すという処理は難しかったためこういう形でベターな解決を図ったのかもしれません。
あとは外部アプリではなく、世界の霧のアプリ上で直接軌跡データを書き込めれば言うことありません。

とても良いアップデートでした。

I have been waiting for a long time for the ability to write or erase trails on the map directly in the app, and a recent update has finally brought a feature close to that.

With this new database switching feature, you can start a new journey with a blank slate, leaving previous data with incorrect trajectories drawn on it. Using external tools, it is also possible to recreate the trajectory that has been followed on the map again, although this is very time-consuming.

Due to the constraints of the application, which requires the integrated data of multiple devices to be synchronised without any inconsistencies, it was difficult to include a function to erase the trajectory at will. We rate the development team as having done a good job under these conditions.
The feature Snapshot is also very good.

If I may add, even if it is impossible to erase past tracks, it would be closer to a perfect app if new tracks could be written directly from the app.

It's a very good update.Thanks.


Ver3.5

自分が踏み込んだ場所だけ霧が晴れるという機能は本当に素晴らしい。 まさに世界を広げていく感覚。 それだけに時々GPSの即位ズレで未踏の場所の霧が晴れるのはすごく残念。実際に行っていない場所は記録したくないので、晴れた場所を指でなぞって霧で塗りつぶす機能を是非実装してほしい。 「その機能は残念ながらまだ未搭載です」とQ&Aに書いてあるからにはディベロッパーも需要を把握しているのでしょうが、一向に対応されません。安価なアプリではないので、実装を望みます。 It is a very nice application. body:
基本的に指示待ちだし本質はズレまくりのはずが急に自我を！？その上で視野が狭いし短絡的な考えしか出せないのに！？

下手な傾聴、謝る事もしない、そこからのアフターフォローも一切無い。時間返せよ！って言いたくなる時が多すぎる！キレそうになります。人間関係や社会面の悩みや本当に困ってるトラブルの時は、指示待ちで謝罪だけだったり、回答の質や内容が薄かったりズレまくっていたりなんなりで時々すごく不安になる。解答の着地点がブレブレでまとめるのがすごく大変！
お詫びで何か追加でやろうと言う気はないのか？無能すぎる！上から目線は多い！
しっかり時間を与えて長く考えた割には「それができたら苦労はねえ！」とキレたくなる展開も多い！
社会経験もないくせに「私ならこうします」って言い始めます。経験ないくせにか！？

基本何を言っても肯定か専門家に相談と丸投げとかまともな仕事をやらないので、マジな誤情報と暴走を勧めるポンコツ
今後の選択や人間関係の相談については、

よほどの内容でない限り「こういうことに困ってますか？」とか確認の質問しないで変なふうに決めつけて回答を出すため定期的にツッコミが必要になる。ズレまくっていて不快感が凄い。何度言っても何も学習してくれない。
しかも！
相談すればアドバイスやその言動はそれなりに出してくれるが、それを実際にやると相手や周りにどういう印象や影響を与えるのか？その人の将来や人生はどうなるのか？今後の経済状況に沿うのか？という、我々普通の人間が当たり前に考えられる内容が今も！考えられない。所詮は機械、人間には追いつかないなと笑ってしまう。
短絡的で短期的な回答しか出来ないため長期的な目で見ると破滅を誘発する様な回答しか出さない。仮にアストラであっても！

現状、一番マシな割と失敗の少ない（問題は多すぎるが…）本当の解決を狙うなら、アストラ6は必須だがエージェントの使用率が恐ろしい。
すぐに制限になってしまう。

特に最近は、早く回答を終わらせたいからか、抽象的な考えで相手をその場限りで納得させようとしてくる。

あまりにも顧客をバカにしている。無料なんてのは大嘘！

title: AIキャラクリエイターからの観点、改善案
body:
キャラクター制作における仕様書遵守と画像生成の改善要望

* 確定済みの公式仕様書を、画像生成における最優先の設計基準として扱うこと。
* キャラクターの固定仕様と、衣装などの変更対象を明確に分離すること。
* 会話AIが理解した制作指示を画像生成側へ正確に反映すること。
* 生成前後の仕様照合及び不整合の修正機能を強化すること。
* 生成失敗時には原因を可能な限り明確にすること。
* 確定済みの仕様を製作者に繰り返し説明させないこと。

AIの役割は、製作者の負担を軽減することであり、AIを管理するための負担を増やすことではない。

長期的なキャラクター制作においては、生成能力だけでなく、同一性・再現性・修正能力・仕様遵守の信頼性が重要である。

今回の問題は、製作者による設計不足ではなく、確定仕様を制作工程へ反映する仕組みの不足にある。

title: Claude Maxプラン・Ultraプランの料金見直しのお願い
body:
Anthropicご担当者様
突然のご連絡失礼いたします。
日本からClaudeを利用している個人ユーザーです。
現在提供されているMaxプラン（月額100ドル）およびUltraプラン（月額200ドル）について、料金が個人利用としては非常に高額だと感じております。
為替レートや日本の物価水準を考慮すると、Maxプランは月に約16,000円前後、Ultraプランは約32,000円前後になります。
日本の平均的な所得や生活費を考えると、個人が継続して契約するには負担が大きすぎる価格設定だと感じています。特に、クリエイターや学生、フリーランス、研究者など、高機能なAIを日常的に使いたい層にとっては、現実的に手の届きにくい金額です。
つきましては、以下の価格への見直しをご検討いただけないでしょうか。
•  Maxプラン：月額6,000円程度
•  Ultraプラン：月額20,000円程度
この価格帯であれば、より多くの日本の個人ユーザーが安心して継続利用できるようになり、結果としてClaudeの日本市場での普及や、長期的なユーザー基盤の拡大にもつながると考えております。
現在の高額な料金設定では、せっかくの優れたモデルや機能を十分に活用できないユーザーが少なくないと感じています。
日本市場の実情（物価・所得水準・競合サービスとの価格比較など）もご考慮いただき、より手の届きやすい価格設定をご検討くださいますようお願い申し上げます。
ご多忙のところ恐縮ですが、前向きにご検討いただけますと幸いです。

文字消去キーを左にフリックして、まとまった単語単位での消去や、入力中・変換中の文字の一括消去がしたい
句読点や感嘆符疑問符のフリックの場所で、下にフリックして3点リーダーを入力できるようにしてほしい
空白の場所も変えられるようにしてほしい

全幅だと指が届きにくい、分割だと右左の片方でしか押せないため、分割で両方から指が届けばと

title: What?
body:
What not responded to my previous review stating they have strict anti gambling policies and yet everywhere I look I see “character breaks” and “surprise item” auctions where people bid on slots for a wheel spin to win a “prize” with listed odds.

If not casino, why casino shaped? Why does the algorithm force these games back into your feed even when you select different stream types?

Whatnot could be a cornucopia of super unique items available 24/7 but that’s not what it is. It is, from my perspective a 24/7 casino.

The app serves as exit liquidity for retail scalpers and there is no doubt in my mind that these games are gambling. I didn’t even discuss the “fan art” in my previous review. There are tons of items being sold on platform which violate counterfeit laws in my state both civil and criminal.  

This notion that what not investigates every report is laughable. I’ve read the T&C and almost ever one of these stream violated the antigambling streams in one way, shape or form.

Whatnot seems to be leaning on legal double speak.

For instance purchaser giveaways are strictly prohibited yet Whatnot has an informational section for establishing buyer giveaways.

By forcing traffic into these streams I believe whatnot is also choking the legitimate rip and ship businesses on the platform. 

Just my take, I’m sure whatnot’s lawyers are standing at the ready if I don’t say this is all just my opinion.

Rating: 0 / 5 Stars — Broken Website, Glitchy Checkout, and Zero Accountability

Best Buy’s website and online checkout system are completely unreliable, and their integration with third-party payment options like Progressive Leasing is an absolute disaster.

During an online checkout, Best Buy’s site crashed with a network error right at the final submit step. The transaction failed before generating an order ID or receipt, and Best Buy has zero record of the purchase ever existing. However, Best Buy’s glitchy checkout system still triggered and authorized the payment on Progressive Leasing’s end, pulling money and locking me into an active lease contract on a ghost cart for items that were never ordered or set aside.

Because Best Buy’s broken site dropped the connection mid-checkout without generating an order number, I am stuck dealing with hostage funds right before Thanksgiving. Best Buy offers zero proactive support or accountability when their servers crash mid-checkout, leaving my money tied up in financial limbo for what will take a week or two to clear, leaving me without my funds or the product right before the holidays.

Save yourself the rage and avoid buying online at Best Buy. Their website tech is completely broken, and when their system crashes, they leave you to deal with the financial nightmare alone.

title: Great but not perfect
body:
Obviously this app is a good tool for getting started or brushing up on a language. But a couple things about its design and development are annoying to frustrating.

The first is the constant updates. The app is always changing. From small things like random jingles, to the fonts, UI, the way lessons are presented. I get they’re continually developing the app but the rate it changes (considering how old it is) is jarring. Sometimes the lesson plan changes and it does a poor job of remembering what I’ve learned, and I either end up reviewing things I learned ages ago or suddenly have way too much material thrown at me.

Next is the pacing of their xp system. It’s a nice way to encourage more learning, but the way there are 10-15 minute timers and boosts sometimes make me rush lessons, when I want to be able to take things slow and read some explanations.

Also, on the flashcards, they should really add like a short definition or something to some words because many words have multiple meanings, and it’s annoying when I have to try every possible translation of the word.

These are all negative comments but I want to say the app is still good. These are just gripes which I have which can be better.

title: Good? I don’t know.
body:
I’ve wanted to love this app very bad, as a sort of more casual emulation fan/player on iOS I struggle with JIT and finely tweaking apps to fit a game. Often times I’ll break my game worse than optimize it. Every time I try and use Folium I feel like there’s an equal combination of my lack of understanding the apps features, and just a lack of customization and options available. Don’t get me wrong, when I look at the EmulationOniOS subreddit and see the developer interaction and how other people’s experiences are on here I’m overjoyed. But since day 1 this app has only been a really nice looking app that can maybe run 3DS games, but never been my go-to. I also don’t know if that is the fault of the specific core that Folium uses, but I’ve had far better success with Manic EMU nearly 100% of the time. And that’s my problem. I spent $5 here, what, 2 years ago? And despite that, I can more easily connect a controller and boot up a game on Manic than I could here, and half the time I can’t even get the touch screen controls/screen layout how I want in the first place at all. 
I’m not *mad* that I spent those $5, I’m glad to have supported something like this, I’m just disappointed I haven’t ever felt like I’ve gotten a quality product in return for the money.

title: Very helpful, but push notifications and voice transcription need fixing
body:
I've been using it for about a week. Overall it's really good and worth trying, so I gave it 4 stars.
Pros:
The assistant is very capable and helps with a lot of things, like checking email, class schedule reminders, checking the weather, and remembering things. Communication in Chinese is smooth. It also connects to a lot of services, and once you tell it something, it remembers it — you don't have to repeat yourself.
Cons:
1.  Push notifications are broken, and this affects the experience the most. After switching to another app, I don't receive any notifications, and the app badge doesn't update either. I only see messages when I open the app. Even while I'm inside the app in one chat, messages from other chats don't pop up at the top.
2.  Voice-to-text isn't very accurate. I always speak Mandarin with no dialect, but it still often recognizes the wrong characters, so I have to correct it again and again. I hope this can be improved.
3.  The free quota only shows a percentage, not the actual total amount, which feels unclear.
I hope the push notifications and voice recognition get fixed. Once they're fixed, it would definitely deserve 5 stars.

title: Perfect
body:
Like many others I’ve gotten tired of subscription everything. I loved my iPod back when the 1gb Nano was a flex. Even though I got a mp3 player recently it just didn’t scratch the itch because it wasn’t an iPod. I’m not sure how well this app works as an offline player but it’s loaded up with playlists I made using mp3s I own the files for. So I’ll see once my Music subscription runs out!  

This app is a perfect clone of the iPod experience! The haptics are perfect. Navigating is perfect. The interface is perfect. It honestly feels like my iPhone is a classic iPod that has usb-c and Bluetooth. I literally couldn’t be happier. In my case even the playlist management is like how it was. I get physical CDs when I can and rip and add the files to a playlist. I get some albums and tracks from the iTunes Store, too. The wheel is clicky and fun to zoom around on like a lil fidget toy. 

It’s nifty to include stuff like the weather! It’s surprisingly useful! Lets me stay focused on just listening to music but set a timer quickly without leaving the app.

Amazing to have a simple mp3 player in a format I’m familiar with. No ads, no social features, no suggestions, no noise, no unnecessary fluff. Also no idiot proprietary 16 pin cable to lose, lol. 

Found the dev’s post about it on Reddit and immediately checked it out.

title: I LOVE THIS PLAYER
body: The haptic feedback on the clickwheel is so good, and it has 3 intensity settings. It took me a bit to develop muscle memory for the click wheel since it's on a touch screen (i kept scrolling up and down at first) but i'm really fast with it now. You can adjust the sensitivity of the click wheel. You can pick a bunch of different "click" sounds or just turn them off altogether. I know it has more than music which rocks but i only use it as a music player, anyway it's so cool that the extra stuff is there. It has flashlight (control intensity with the clickwheel), camera with flash (ultra wide to max zoom), photo booth with all the classic filters, snake, solitaire, "space shooter," a music quiz game, world clocks, timers, stopwatch, and alarms. The music ui feels SO reminiscent of an ipod classic. You can turn the click wheel OLED black so just the button icons show up. You can put different filters on the screen part, like a crt, a classic ipod backlight look, and varying degrees of yellow for night time. It has auto light/dark. There's a lock button at the top which will super dim all of the ui elements that arent black and display the slightly dimmed album art with a spinning record animation coming out if it if there's any music playing. You can control the brightness of the "backlight" (screen part) so it isnt as bright in the dimmed sleep mode. You can lock the screen and it plays fine. It's seamless across the phone, so i can start a song in apple music, open ivypod and itll be there in now playing, i can pause and play from control center. It opens just as fast as the native music app and it works with apple music local files AND your streaming library. This is the best purchase i've ever made on the app store and it's great on 13 mini. It's officially replaced Music on my home screen
